audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 and First item were 'Skill', Level 6 and 2+ items were 'Lucian' — while whys[3] through whys[6] on those same rows say her W cancels your dash, her E wall-stun kills you, her R knocks you out of The Culling, and she out-scales you as a tank.
audit.why: 37.5% win rate and the packet chart gives Poppy every stage from Levels 4-5 on. The prose was already right; only the tokens disagreed.
audit.corrected: win[2]/phases[2].side -> Skill (whys[2] literally says 'call it even'); win[3..6]/phases[3..6].side -> Poppy.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3..6].why were the generic Lucian boilerplate; none named a Poppy spike.
audit.why: Her curve is Steadfast Presence at 2-3 (20/18/16/14/12s), Heroic Charge wall-stun from 3, Keeper's Verdict at 6 (140/120/100s), then armour at first item.
audit.corrected: Each stage now names the Poppy ability that owns it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two places say Poppy chains 'Q knockup' after the wall stun, and whys[0] calls her passive a 'terrain shield'.
audit.why: Hammer Shock (Q) creates a slowing zone that explodes after a delay — it does not knock up. The only knockup in her kit is Keeper's Verdict (R). Her passive is Iron Ambassador: she throws a buckler and gains a shield if she picks it back up — nothing to do with terrain.
audit.corrected: Q chains as a slow-and-explode zone; the passive is a pick-up shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: zero sequencing cues. Every line said 'commit on Steadfast Presence's cooldown' without ever giving it.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence is 20s at rank 1 falling to 12s — one of the longest relevant cooldowns in the lane, which makes it genuinely countable and makes the advice actionable rather than decorative.
audit.corrected: 20s at rank 1 written into dosFull[0]; the passive resist scaling into dontsFull[0].

notes: The level chart was the whole problem here — the written analysis is accurate and consistently Poppy-favoured from level 3, while the chart handed Lucian four stages including Level 6, the exact stage the same page calls her strongest. Untargetability during Keeper's Verdict is taken from the repo's own applicable-interactions list (_missing key 33), not inferred from Riot's text, which says only that she channels the strike. diff HARD vs 'Even matchup — 5.5/10' in two prose strings is a pre-existing internal disagreement left for a deliberate call.
